description: The chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple datasets/metrics using grouped vertical bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks (left to right): GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, and it is labeled “Dataset and Metrics”; the categories appear in the listed order without an indicated sorting rule. The vertical axis is labeled “Score (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows two adjacent bars: a blue bar for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and an orange bar for the second model (orange series as shown in the legend). Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~79 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA shows only an orange bar at ~60 with no visible blue bar; ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (×5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The tallest bars are around 80 on GSM-8K, and the shortest visible bar is around 20 on Chat-Arena-Hard (blue). No bars appear specially emphasized beyond the standard color coding and the legend.
